description.en: A DSH client plugin that helps you sign in to your own Faxin (faxin.cn) legal database account and gives the AI structured retrieval of statutes, judicial interpretations, judicial documents and adjudication rules, limited to the content your account can access.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件：登录你自己的法信(faxin.cn)法律数据库账号后，为 AI 提供法律法规、司法解释/司法文件、裁判规则等的结构化检索（仅限账号权限内内容，低频按需使用）。
